name: Fragments of the Past
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.

narrative.details:
I did not realize... Forgive my callous words, champion.

The mistakes of my ancestors are not what I wish to dwell on, but if your request is truly genuine, then I will help you.

<Aurora examines the fragments.>

I believe this is the Crystal of Zin-Malor, an artifact that can contain and control strong arcane forces. It could have been used for good, but the evil intentions of those that stole it caused it to shatter.

Go to the Temple of Zin-Malor in Azshara - I can only hope the book is still there.
narrative.objectives: Find the Sacred Highborne Writings in the Temple of Zin-Malor in Azshara, and bring them to Aurora Skycaller near the Northpass Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.
narrative.offerRewardText: The pages have gone untouched for many many years...
narrative.requestItemsText: It is only in the pages of the sacred writings that I will be able to discern whether or not I can help you...

chain.subtitle: 9 quests from level 56 to 58, 34,825 XP in all.

quests.name: To Winterspring!
quests.objectiveText: Find Starfall Village in Winterspring and speak with Wynd Nightchaser.

quests.name: Starfall
quests.objectiveText: Find Starfall in Winterspring and speak with Wynd Nightchaser.

quests.name: The Ruins of Kel'Theril
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Jaron Stoneshaper in Starfall Village.

quests.name: Troubled Spirits of Kel'Theril
quests.objectiveText: Use Jaron's Pick to find the four Highborne Relic Fragments.

quests.name: Fragments of the Past
quests.objectiveText: Find the Sacred Highborne Writings in the Temple of Zin-Malor in Azshara, and bring them to Aurora Skycaller near the Northpass Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.

quests.name: Fragments of the Past
quests.objectiveText: Bring an Enchanted Thorium Bar, 5 Crystal Restore, and a Vial of Dire Water to Aurora Skycaller near the Northpass Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.

quests.name: Tormented By the Past
quests.objectiveText: Take the Crystal of Zin-Malor to Lake Kel'Theril in Winterspring and find a highborne spirit that will speak to you.

quests.name: Remorseful Highborne
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Wynd Nightchaser in Starfall Village, and ask about the proper place for the Crystal of Zin-Malor.

quests.name: The Crystal of Zin-Malor
quests.objectiveText: Deliver the Crystal of Zin-Malor to Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm in Darnassus.
